description: CMF pin-field patch set over the pinned vanilla 5.01 panel. Each find is matched in a fresh FFDec 26.3.0 export (CRLF normalised to LF) exactly 'count' times. The panel reads only CMF's own fields and names. Every shown filter tab is reported to scripts as OnCMFMapFilter(tab name). StaticMapPinData declares CMF's pin fields, then, as compatibility names CMF never reads, Map Quest Insight's qmi* and Ink and Iron's iaiLv/iaiDiff pin fields: the game drops writes to undeclared fields, and those mods' CMF adapters read them back and turn them into CMF claims. Pin size scales the icon, alt highlight and glow from their recorded bases; labels sit below signposts and above other pins; id 1 accepts frame:<label>. HubMap skips the crosshair label on request, raises a selected pin's label above the crosshair and leaves pins out of the tabs their cmfTabHide names. MapMenu draws the scrolling info box at cmfDescMaxH (inputs, sounds and bar as Map Quest Insight's map), unchanged from the game while cmfDescMaxH is 0; from version 12 a tall box leaves the game's place only through the tooltip tall* keys. HubMap carries only the line FFDec needs to recompile it (Stage 2 round trip, no behaviour change): CenterOnPin's NaN defaults become undefined as Map Pin Teleport 1.2.2 ships it. MapMenu carries the same kind of line, the pointer-manager init call looked up by name as Fog of War 1.2.1 ships it, plus a display-only key-hint copy: it registers cmf.map.hints, calls OnCMFMapHintsReady once, and draws what arrives with the game's own ModuleInputFeedback, ignoring keys and the mouse, at Ink and Iron's place, 0.8 scale about the row's centre and dark glow (values the Stage 6b theme API will carry instead). Stage 6b map theme (API 5): MapMenu registers cmf.map.theme and calls OnCMFMapThemeReady, keeps the parts' styles in MapMenu.cmfStyles and draws each part's shapes (rect, ring, ellipse, polygon, band; plain or linear graded fills with a curve; glows and drop shadows; repeat copies) in its own layers, re-measured every frame and redrawn only when a box, state or view changes. Parts are measured by one rule (visible text trimmed to its width plus 8 px, track and pin icons whole; key rows, tab arrows and scroll arrows by their buttons). HubMapContainer draws mapEdge shapes in map space, hides the edge gradients on request and limits panning to the map area; TooltipMap, InputFeedbackButton, KeyboardButtonIcon, HubMapPinCategoryItemRenderer and StaticMapPinDescribed apply fonts, colours, hidden plates, key caps, legend colours, pin label place, label colour (cmfLabelColor) and label shapes. Every theme edit only adds lines; with no theme registered the map is unchanged. Map-space drawing (version 6): MapMenu listens to cmf.map.space (sent per map build) and asks for it with OnCMFMapSpaceReady; HubMapContainer draws mapSpace line, text and movie drawings in two layers inside the map (under: just above the tiles; over: above the edge fade; both below every pin), with an optional copy in the corner overview; a movie drawing loads the author's own movie by game path with a Loader and calls its cmfMapSpace(data, map); a drawing key tab shows a drawing only while that legend tab is selected and adds the tab, pinless, when no pin makes it; text drawings, hover keys and click 1 on drawings tied to screen parts, a click reported as OnCMFDrawingClicked(id, click value); a drawing key listen takes a drawing's lists and text from a storage key its mod's script writes; above stacks a drawing over its anchor; map-space layers follow the map tiles' fade-in. Version 9 (world overview pictures, controller button pictures, the map's view): MapMenu registers cmf.map.world and cmf.map.view before OnCMFMapThemeReady and keeps one picture cache for the whole map (one load per url, a failed url is not tried again in the opening, results sent once per slot as OnCMFPictureNote(line)); UniverseMapContainer puts the painting (one picture or {x}/{y} tiles) in a holder just above the game's painting child, also in the hover copy, hiding the game's child only once every tile shows, and the crests and overview markers in holders over their children that copy the child's transform and colour whenever the clip's timeline moves (a region another mod adds gets customUILoader.source); InputFeedbackButton draws a button picture at the end of SetupGamepadIcon over the frame's picture children (holdIndicator and viewrect untouched), loads the family in use first and sets the button up again when a picture arrives late. MapMenu keeps cmfViewOk, cmfViewX, cmfViewY, cmfViewWX, cmfViewWY and cmfViewZoom current while a region map is shown, calls OnCMFMapView(x, y, worldX, worldY, zoom) once the map has been still for 250 ms after a move, and calls OnCMFMapOpening one frame after each SetMapSettings (or at once when HubMap places the map sooner); HubMap applies the cmf.map.view answer in the frame the map is placed, or when it arrives, only on the usual opening place and only while the map has not moved, clamped to the zoom limits in force, and keeps it through the show animation's zoom reset. With no cmf.map.world entries and no view answer the map is unchanged. Version 10 (wide and tall screens, names on hover, map ready at fade start): MapMenu registers cmf.map.screen (the window in pixels) before OnCMFMapThemeReady and, when the theme arrives, lays the map out for CommonUtils.getScreenRect(): on a rect wider than 1922 or taller than 1082 (and fill not 0) the map mask, backing, edge frame, visible area, mouse area, pin arrows and marker dimmer reach the rect's left, right and bottom, the side and bottom panels move out by the wide part's panels share (also where the game re-places the legend), theme numbers move by cmfWideX/cmfWideY and the drawing key wideAnchor, the screen and map parts, backdrop, pan limit and info-box limits use the filled screen, and world 1 scales the overview to its width; a stretched stage (window wider than 16:9, rect not) is drawn narrower about x 960 first. Only the difference to the last layout is applied; the 16:9 rect returns before any member is written. The layout is logged once per opening through OnCMFPanelNote (wide screen=... or wide off) and reported as OnCMFScreen(width, height). StaticMapPinData declares cmfHoverName and cmfHoverNameBy: bit 1 shows a pin's label line and tag drawings only on the hovered pin, bit 2 writes its name on the hovered copy. HubMap.handleShowTimer with the opening key readyAtFadeStart takes input and shows the panels as the fade starts; revealEase eases the reveal in. Map blur fix (1.6.1): MapMenu.handleInput passes every input event to HubMap.cmfNavInput first, so a movement key's release always clears the flag its press set, also where the map drops the release; cmfNavClear (called by CMF's script on an input device change, and on the panel's activate and deactivate events) clears held movement keys and the game's key repeat; cmfNavWatch logs one 'nav burst' line per burst of zoom or movement, naming what moved the map; it shows every zoom level's hidden loaded squares again (the game hides them at a focus change and never shows them again, so the coarse background shows through): on every movement tick for 3 s after an input device change, where the first tick also keeps the current level on top and asks the other levels to hide, and every 250 ms otherwise, logging the level stack and the squares' state as 'nav layers'.
